dedupe_keys.name: npws ireland maps and data protected sites habitats and species

description: The National Parks and Wildlife Service of Ireland publishes maps and data on habitats and species, protected sites and national parks and reserves. The designated site data page offers downloads of designated site boundary data, a search for site documents, Site Specific Conservation Objectives (SSCO) GIS and tabular data (April 2025 release), and the latest summary datasheets for Special Areas of Conservation and Special Protection Areas; there is also a protected sites map viewer and map viewers for species under the Flora Protection Order. The NPWS open data policy makes open data the default, licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0, with the exact reuse terms and attribution in each dataset's metadata, while some datasets, such as locations of rare species or third-party data, are only available on request under sensitive data guidelines. Caveats: users are asked to read the advisory notes on data usage and limitations. Coverage is Ireland. It supports green infrastructure planning and environmental constraint screening for infrastructure routes, and coastal and wetland adaptation; related records are the Forestry Commission Land Information Search and the BfN urban ecosystems map.
